latest.title: Disney plans several thousand layoffs, asks some managers to cut costs by up to 20%

latest.title: Epidemic of Hacked Freezers Spreads Across Europe
latest.description: A suspected hacking wave has pushed supermarket freezers into defrost mode across ten European countries, with temperatures reportedly hitting 50°C. Nobody knows who's behind it or why it spread.

latest.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
latest.description: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.

latest.title: Shopify falls 7% after Q3 revenue and merchandise volume miss estimates
latest.description: Shopify stock fell after the e-commerce platform's Q3 revenue and gross merchandise volume missed estimates, despite an adjusted earnings beat.

latest.title: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng says hackers used fake job interviews, AI tool to steal $6.3 billion in crypto
latest.description: Binance has replenished 98% of $6.34 billion in affected assets, according to a security report the crypto exchange issued Tuesday.

latest.title: South Korea's president says country needs a ‘cybersecurity czar’ following $6.3 billion Binance hack
latest.description: Lee Jae Myung said he wants a government-wide agency to tackle cyberattacks as AI raises security concerns across financial institutions and critical infrastructure.

latest.title: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen
latest.description: Markus Thielen sees Bitcoin reaching $90,000 by year-end, questions institutional ETF demand and says Ethereum must do more for holders.

latest.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
latest.description: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to the exchange’s investigation.

latest.title: Bill Ackman warns of 'casino' stock market as speculative trading grows
latest.description: "We're back to the casino-type markets when there was 95% leverage," said the founder of Pershing Square Capital Management.

latest.title: Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX join OKX–ICE tokenized stock objections as deadline looms
latest.description: Objections have reached 56 companies, with nearly 80% of the venture’s initial stock selection opting out.

latest.title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
latest.description: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.

latest.title: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
latest.description: The BLS reported job openings at 7.52 million, up 333,000 from August and well above the Dow Jones consensus outlook for 7.15 million

latest.title: Trump midterm election lawsuits, state pushback come to a head Tuesday
latest.description: "There's no doubt that the threats are threats to our democracy," said John Cusick, assistant counsel at the Legal Defense Fund.

latest.title: UK Says AI-Powered Ransomware Attack on Critical Infrastructure 'Highly Likely' by 2028
latest.description: The National Cyber Security Centre said AI will expose security flaws "tolerated for far too long," and called time on "tech on the cheap."

latest.title: Crude oil prices fall for second day as market hopes for diplomatic resolution to Iran war
latest.description: The rebound in oil prices come a day after the U.S. and Iranian presidents signalled they are open to a diplomatic solution to Iran war.

latest.title: What the 2026 midterm elections could mean for Trump's final two years
latest.description: Oddsmakers and public polls place Democrats in a favorable position ahead of Election Day.

latest.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’
latest.description: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.
